title: SpaceX plans a gas-fired power plant and super-compute facility in Starbase, TX, with ~$24B of investment for initial phases, per a public hearing notice (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: SpaceX plans a gas-fired power plant and super-compute facility in Starbase, TX, with ~$24B of investment for initial phases, per a public hearing notice — SpaceX plans to construct, own and operate a gas-fired power plant and super-compute facility at its company town in Starbase, Texas …
